definitions.explanation: A formal or trade term for leather and animal hides, especially in industrial and manufacturing contexts. The everyday word for leather is {革|かわ}.

examples.japanese: {皮革|ひかく}を{使|つか}った{製品|せいひん}。
{皮革|ひかく}{産業|さんぎょう}は{長|なが}い{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: The leather industry has a long history.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}では{高品質|こうひんしつ}な{皮革|ひかく}を{使|つか}って{靴|くつ}を{製造|せいぞう}している。
examples.english: This factory manufactures shoes using high-quality leather.

notes:
Composed of {皮|ひ} (skin) + {革|かく} (leather). A formal term used mainly in industry, business, and technical writing. In everyday speech, {革|かわ} is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮革|ひかく}{産業|さんぎょう}: leather industry
- {皮革|ひかく}{製品|せいひん}: leather goods
- {皮革|ひかく}{加工|かこう}: leather processing / tanning
- {天然|てんねん}{皮革|ひかく}: genuine leather
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}: synthetic leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {革|かわ}: leather — the everyday word; used for finished leather goods ({革|かわ}の{財布|さいふ}, a leather wallet)
- {皮|かわ}: skin; hide — the raw, untanned material; also means peel or shell
- レザー: leather — common loanword in fashion and product names
